verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for a structured llms.txt at support.claude.com, which lists Help Center content such as release notes in an agent-readable index. That delivers the story's 'point an agent at llms.txt' path directly. The evidence is only a probe snippet: per-page markdown docs returned 404, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: per-page markdown or other agent-oriented doc variants (the .md probe 404'd), evidence of llms.txt coverage beyond the Help Center (e.g. API/developer docs), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
